value.rationale: Natural shortest common supersequence problem for all binary length-k palindromes, intrinsically optimal host length 2k. Index-refined exhaustive classification through 15 reveals a large genuine gap between palindrome-only and unrestricted universality, including 728116 non-full-universal hosts and a sharp minimal index 11 with 72 hosts at k15; this is a motivated exact finite classification, not arbitrary sample.
